messages:
Priya (PM): Quick thread to decide pilot scope for two enterprise prospects. Core ask: BYOK/KMS handshake, signed export bundles with SHA256 manifest, retention lanes up to 7y, and export SLA tiers. Target: pilot in 5 weeks. Quick takes?
Ethan (Eng): Implementation path: JSONL snapshotter -> gzipped parts -> manifest -> signer. Rewrap keys for rotation. Major risk is export runtime for TB-scale tenants.
Rhea (Security): BYOK must allow customer-signed manifests (JWK) or our HSM fallback. Default: redact content, include content_hash, sampling: control-plane 100%/content 5% opt-in to 100%. Document forensic limits when sampling.
Tom (Legal): Need chain-of-custody language and retention-exception API. No default key escrow. I'll draft an addendum and a standard export affidavit template.
Darren (Sales): Customers will pay for 7y cold archive + export SLA. Ask: include SOC2/ISO attachments in export? One prospect needs VPC BYOK.
Priya (PM): Proposal: retention lanes = ephemeral(30d), standard(1yr), enterprise(7yr). BYOK flow: upload pubkey -> handshake token -> confirm. Pilot export SLA: best-effort <4h, gold <2h. Agree to target alpha?
Ethan (Eng): Alpha good for speed. We'll need schema signoff and infra cost estimate. I'll prototype exporter and post estimate in 10 days.
Rhea (Security): I'll produce a security checklist (KMS patterns, signing, sampling caveats) in 4 days.
Tom (Legal): Draft addendum by Tue AM. Will mark any non-negotiables.
infra-bot: Created ticket INFR-6044: "Enterprise evidence pilot - BYOK & export SLAs" assigned to Ethan (Eng). ETA 5 weeks.
Priya (PM): Action items recap and reconvene next Wed 9am PT. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
